findings.text: _profile_cache_root now lets RECKON_HOME outrank XDG_CACHE_HOME, which is the right isolation fix, but the docstring's first sentence still claims the cache is 'outside every repository, so a cache write never dirties a checkout'. That guarantee is now conditional on RECKON_HOME itself resolving outside any checkout: a host or sandbox that sets RECKON_HOME to a directory inside a repo would have the picker write <RECKON_HOME>/cache/run-time-profile/<project>.json into that checkout. Not observed on this workstation (RECKON_HOME here resolves under ~/.config/reckon, outside every repo), so this is a documentation/robustness follow-on rather than a live defect. Fix: either qualify the sentence to state the RECKON_HOME precedence and its consequence, or have _profile_cache_root refuse a home that resolves inside a git work tree.

VERDICT goal: the reviewed node bounds a pick's cost by the number of live foreign projects by reusing each project's run-time profile while its ledger is unchanged. This review covers only the two commits the run gained after the earlier review read afec9a9f..830e715: e1643e990 (perf(picker): cache the pick's own profile and isolate the cache by home) and 800be5be9 (docs(evidence): record the own-project profile cache and the cache-root order). e1643e990 fixes exactly the two follow-on findings the earlier review raised against 830e715: it reorders _profile_cache_root so RECKON_HOME outranks XDG_CACHE_HOME (the earlier finding that the suite's RECKON_HOME isolation did not cover the cache whenever XDG_CACHE_HOME was set), and it routes build()'s own-project branch through _cached_run_time_profile instead of the uncached run_time_profile (the earlier finding that a fresh-process pick still decoded its own project's ledger once per pick). Both are done and independently reproduced; the node's goal remains met and the expected-wait answer is unchanged.
VERDICT done_when: the gained commit addresses both raised defects with the mechanism the earlier review named -- home-before-XDG precedence stated in the docstring, and the own-project profile cached under the same stamp key as the foreign ones -- and adds exactly the two cases that pin them, plus an evidence-fragment update. The prior hermeticity cut (the two in-process cases escaping RECKON_HOME isolation under a set XDG_CACHE_HOME) is resolved by the new precedence; the earlier segment's cross-process case and negative control remain intact.
VERDICT write_paths: the reviewed range 830e715..800be5be changes three paths, all within the node's declared grants -- reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py, tests/test_picker_foreign_wait_is_bounded.py and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/picker-foreign-wait-bounded.html -- and leaves grant-holder run_time_profile.py unchanged (the cache stays in the picker consumer); no plan, sprint or index state was mutated.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, after_suite at 800be5be is 124 passed exit 0 and baseline_suite at afec9a9f is 119 passed exit 0, negative_control-2.log 2 failed/3 deselected EXIT=1; both gained commits are conventional with a body and no AI trailer.
VERDICT diff: 830e715..800be5be adds two behaviours and their evidence -- _profile_cache_root's resolution order swapped to RECKON_RUN_TIME_PROFILE_CACHE, RECKON_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, ~/.cache with the reason stated in the docstring; build()'s 'elif project:' branch changed from run_time_profile(project, now=moment) to _cached_run_time_profile(project, now=moment); plus two new test cases (a both-homes precedence probe and a two-process build() own-project reuse driver) and the fragment's own-project figures, resolution-order paragraph and expanded negative-control paragraph.
VERDICT call_sites: the cached path is entered from two production call sites in the reviewed head -- lane_context.py:476 (_expected_wait, the foreign-owner branch) and lane_context.py:589 (build, the pick's own project when records is None) -- with the internal fall-throughs to the uncached run_time_profile inside _cached_run_time_profile at lane_context.py:412 and lane_context.py:404.

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: both defects the earlier review raised are fixed exactly, by the mechanism it named, and independently reproduced. I re-ran the node's new test file alone in a fresh git-archive extraction of 800be5be (module __file__ in the scratch tree) -- 5 passed EXIT=0 -- and separately mutated each fix back to its pre-fix form: restoring the XDG-before-RECKON_HOME order fails exactly test_the_persisted_cache_prefers_reckon_home (1 failed / 4 passed EXIT=1), and restoring the uncached build() own-project read fails exactly test_a_fresh_process_with_no_records_reads_no_ledger (1 failed / 4 passed EXIT=1, the second process re-reading 'own-project'). The expected-wait answer is unchanged in every arm (420.0 in the drivers), so the cuts are behaviour-preserving; the figure still counts every live local worker.
SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the reviewed run's own arms are sound and I reproduced a head arm independently: gate-base.log is 119 passed EXIT=0 at afec9a9f (scratch tree, module __file__ named on the header) and gate-head.log is 124 passed EXIT=0 at 800be5be (worktree), with zero failures in both, so added_failure_count is 0 with no added ids. My independent head-arm re-run of tests/test_picker_foreign_wait_is_bounded.py in a fresh extraction of the reviewed head is 5 passed EXIT=0, and my two independent mutations each produce the red the node claims. The cut: I re-ran only the node's own test file, not the whole picker gate, in my scratch tree, so the full-suite head figure is taken from the run's own gate-head.log; and both fixes are cheap to re-verify but the persisted key still folds only the date, so a profile computed early in a day is reused all day (documented, sub-day accuracy).
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the range touches only three paths, all granted; run_time_profile.py is granted and correctly untouched (the cache belongs in the picker consumer); the changes are local commits, and no plan, sprint or shared index state was mutated.

JUSTIFICATION durability: each raised behaviour is pinned by its own case and shown to be load-bearing by an independent red control I reproduced (cache-root order -> test_the_persisted_cache_prefers_reckon_home; own-project cache -> test_a_fresh_process_with_no_records_reads_no_ledger), and the node's own negative-control-2.log reverts both forms together for 2 failed/3 deselected. Both commits carry conventional subjects and bodies with no AI trailer. Cut: the persisted freshness key folds the ledger stamp and the window's end date but not the profile's own parameters, safe only because _cached_run_time_profile hardcodes the default window.

Not observed on this workstation (RECKON_HOME resolves under ~/.config/reckon, outside every repo), so it is a documentation/robustness follow-on rather than a live defect.
